title: sprintProgress: report completion percentage
heading: SP2-2: sprint progress report
body:
**Source:** SPEC.md §4 · test/sprint.test.js

Implement `sprintProgress(board)` in `src/sprint.js`.

**Acceptance:**
- Returns { total, done, remaining, percentComplete }.
- percentComplete = round(done/total*100), integer 0..100.
- Empty board = 100% complete.
- Tests in test/sprint.test.js for sprintProgress pass.
- Do not edit the tests.
